description: This file defines the CKEDITOR.scriptLoader object, which provides methods to asynchronously load external JavaScript files and execute inline scripts within the CKEditor environment.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.scriptLoader
classes.description: Object providing methods to load scripts asynchronously and execute code within CKEditor.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads one or more external scripts asynchronously, with optional callback upon completion.

methods.name: loadCode
methods.description: Executes a string of JavaScript code directly into the current document.
